verdict.rationale: Code ownership and required approvals are a fair axis for a Git forge like Gitea, so this applies. The evidence only documents general pull request review and user permission/ACL management. Nothing mentions CODEOWNERS files, path-based ownership, or mandatory code-owner approval before merge, and those adjacent review and permission features earn no credit.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can require approval from designated code owners for changes to the paths they own
